name: Eikonal Omega Term Computation
definition: Computes the Eikonal constraint term involving second-order derivatives of the hash grid encoding, supporting two backpropagation implementations: double backprop and second-order dOmega.
summary: Eikonal Omega Term Computation calculates gradients for hash grid features to optimize neural field gradient magnitude, distinguishing itself by explicitly handling second-order derivative dependencies via double backpropagation or second-order methods.
